verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials are a fair question for a package manager, since registries can issue granular tokens, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way to issue API credentials of any kind. Homebrew's JSON API is documented as unauthenticated, and controls like per-item tap trust, non-admin installs and HOMEBREW_NO_SUDO govern installation permissions, not agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
